A '''Silver sickle emerald (blessed)''' is made by embedding an [[emerald]] into a [[Silver sickle(b)|blessed silver sickle]] with a [[chisel]], granting 20 [[Crafting]] [[experience]]. It can be used to Cast [[Bloom]] like the blessed silver sickle, but can be no longer wielded, as the "emerald upsets the balance of the sickle".

During and after the [[Legacy of Seergaze]] [[quest]], [[Enchant Level 2 Jewellery]] spell can be used on the sickle to make an [[Enchanted sickle emerald(b)]].

==Trivia                            ==

*Although a blessed sickle is used in the making of the item, the actual blade seems to have lost the white tinge visible on blessed sickles.
